newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA RENEL TO RAISE $100 MLN IN CORPORATE BONDS.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA RENEL TO RAISE $100 MLN IN CORPORATE BONDS.

text.p: Romania's electricity authority said on Wednesday it would raise this week $100 million from a corporate bond issue launched through Merrill Lynch International.
"Renel will sign with Merrill Lynch the documents concluding the corporate bonds issue worth $100 million in London on February 13," Renel said in a statement.
It said the placement had enjoyed "great interest" from Asian and U.S. investors.
Merrill Lynch officials were not available for comment.
